name: Candy
overview: Scripture uses imagery of sweetness, such as honey and honeycomb, to illustrate the desirability and goodness of God's promises and words. The land promised to Israel is described as flowing with milk and honey, symbolizing abundance and blessing (Joshua 5:6). God's words and presence are portrayed as sweeter and more precious than gold or honey, inviting believers to taste and trust in His goodness (Psalms 19:10; 34:8; 119:103). Pleasant and wholesome speech is likened to honeycomb, bringing sweetness to the soul and health to the body (Proverbs 16:24), emphasizing the nourishing and life-giving nature of God's truth.
